messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 14):
"""
The CEO of the Insurer shall have an overall responsibility for ensuring that a robust due diligence process is in place to mitigate risks arising from the products and shall countersign the relevant certifications. II. The Advertisement Committee (AC): 1. The AC shall approve every advertisement of the Insurer in compliance with the provisions of IRDAI (Protection of Policyholders’ Interests, Operations and Allied Matters of Insurers) Regulations, 2024 and Master Circular issued thereunder. 2. The AC shall be constituted with a minimum of two Key Management Persons (KMP), three Senior Management Officials one level below the KMP and a permanent invitee from PMC of the Insurer (refer under 6(1)(c) of IRDAI (Insurance Products) Regulation, 2024). 3. The quorum for the AC shall be 3 members including one KMP and the permanent invitee from PMC D. Product Filing I.
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"Who must countersign the certifications related to due diligence processes for an insurer's products?","answer":"The CEO of the insurer must countersign the relevant certifications.","facts":["The CEO of the Insurer shall have an overall responsibility for ensuring that a robust due diligence process is in place to mitigate risks arising from the products and shall countersign the relevant certifications."]},{"question":"What is the minimum composition of the Advertisement Committee for an insurer?","answer":"The Advertisement Committee must include at least two Key Management Persons, three Senior Management Officials one level below the KMP, and a permanent invitee from the PMC of the insurer.","facts":["The AC shall be constituted with a minimum of two Key Management Persons (KMP), three Senior Management Officials one level below the KMP and a permanent invitee from PMC of the Insurer (refer under 6(1)(c) of IRDAI (Insurance Products) Regulation, 2024)."]}]}
